pages.rationale: The page is a short safety checklist; a product image could imply that the interface replaces machine-side verification.
The tables are searchable, accessible, and more useful than an image of key labels.
The page is a compact compatibility table with no spatial workflow to illustrate.
The field and validation tables are the authoritative reference; editor visuals belong on the Machines task page.
Copyable commands and report examples are more useful than a terminal screenshot.
The page is a message lookup; representative warning states are proposed on the task pages where they occur.
A searchable term list does not gain useful meaning from a decorative image.
The page explains storage and network boundaries; an interface image would not clarify those guarantees.
